summary: Builds a 3D texture or 2D texture array from a sequence of TOP images, with controls for slice replacement, prefill, and cache depth.

key_params.name: prefill
key_params.note: Fill slices from input over a frame sequence.

key_params.name: cachesize
key_params.note: Number of slices in the texture/cache.

common_gotchas: Prefill cooks upstream inputs at frame-sequence values, so upstream animation or indexing affects slice contents.
Step changes which source frames become slices during prefill.
2D texture arrays do not blend along W and do not have W extend mode behavior like 3D textures.
GPU memory usage scales quickly with slice count, resolution, and pixel format.
key_concepts: Texture 3D TOP stores a series of images as slices in a 3D texture or 2D texture array.
Active replacement writes one slice per frame and wraps through the cache.
3D textures use normalized W coordinates and can blend between slices; 2D texture arrays use non-normalized W and do not blend between slices.
Locking the operator preserves the full 3D/array data in saved .toe or .tox files.
